correctness.rationale: The known source polynomial is exactly the numerator of the two-parameter collision equation after removing the diagonal. Substitution y=sx gives the Kummer model, with seven distinct branch places of valuations 1,1,-3,-1,-1,-1,4 in characteristic away from 2,3,7. Riemann-Hurwitz for the degree-seven separable cover gives genus 15. Power 7 is bijective on Fq^× when gcd(7,q-1)=1, giving one rational point per base point including rational total-ramification points, and the exact pair and moment counts by inclusion-exclusion. verify_symbolic.py and verify_counts.py run from package files; finite runs corroborate, do not replace universal proof. The plane degree gives arithmetic genus 28, whence delta total 13; the rational-point discrepancy between plane curve and normalization is bounded in absolute value by delta total, yielding #B(Fq)>=q+1-30sqrt(q)-13 by Weil.

value.rationale: The collision curve is the central geometric instrument of the published existence estimate for plane-filling curves. Determining its exact normalization genus (15 rather than relying on degree-nine arithmetic genus 28) exposes a ramified cyclic seven-cover and refines the available geometric point-count framework. Its exact q+1 rational point law on the congruence class gcd(7,q-1)=1 yields the first exact second factorial moment for simultaneous rational singularities of the pencil, a natural incidence-distribution invariant not supplied by the first-moment census. This links the geometry of the source proof to a uniform arithmetic formula rather than an arbitrary numerical slice. The resulting explicit plane-model lower bound q+1-30sqrt(q)-13 improves the geometric error coefficient used in the original proof.
